description: This file defines the Adapter class representing configuration properties for a protocol adapter within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes properties such as enabled status, type, device authentication requirement, and extension properties, along with corresponding accessor and mutator methods.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: Represents the configuration for a protocol adapter, including properties like type, enablement, device authentication requirement, and extensions. Provides fluent API methods for configuration.

methods.name: Adapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Adapter with a required type, ensuring it is non-null.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether devices can connect using this adapter; returns the Adapter instance for chaining.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is enabled for device connections.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type name of the adapter.

methods.name: setDeviceAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Sets whether device authentication is required; returns the Adapter instance for chaining.

methods.name: isDeviceAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Checks if device authentication is required.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Replaces existing extension properties with the provided map; returns Adapter for chaining.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the extension properties.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces a single extension property; returns Adapter for chaining.
